messages.subject: Looking for host university
parts:
Hello!
I'm young scientist in Public Health from Russia. I have background in medicine, statistics and informatic. I've developed a database, which include demografic, health, social and economic data. 
The oficial data by regions of Russian Federation were input into the database for several years. Also, the interface was developed on the web-site, which allows researchers input data from varied sources (the region's names recognize automatically). There is an access for each user on the site.
The data was used in several researches. That helped to compute some models of deseases using statistical packages. I'm looking forward to set that models in the database with R and Rapache. Also, visualization in graphs and maps could be created on the site.
I'm going to apply in Fulbright programm with this science work.
I was very happy If anybody would interested in one of the issues I listed!

With sicerely, Sergey Vladimirov!
